Name: June Ridgeside Village Portrait Mod
Author: jemmielemmie
Description:
This mod replaces June's portrait from Ridgeside Village.
Inspired by BBBoong's pixel artstyle in their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9203?tab=posts]portrait mod[/url].
Unfinished ﻿(No wedding reception and seasonal outifts yet)

How to install:
1. Extract the zip file.
2. Open the Mods folder, and open Ridgeside Village's folder. In [CP] Ridgeside Village, open Assets.
3. To replace June's regular portrait, go to the Portraits folder and paste June.png. Replace the existing file.
4. To replace June's beach portrait, go to the BeachPortraits folder and paste June_beach.png. Replace the existing file.

HI! I'm not much of an artist and this is my first mod. Do let me know if you encounter any issues!
